mission: Create a repeatable legal and operational pathway for channel-to-channel Gospel distribution worldwide.
default_model: non-exclusive unless a definitive agreement expressly states otherwise
commercial_rule: Payment or sponsorship never purchases editorial approval, airtime, ministry endorsement or preferential treatment.
rights_rule: No worldwide rights are assumed. Each agreement must expressly state territory, language, media, term, exclusivity and permitted uses.
distribution_rule: External broadcasters and platforms are distribution partners; IZAKHONO retains YHVH network editorial authority unless a definitive agreement states otherwise.
territory_strategy: Worldwide acquisition across Africa, Middle East, Europe, North America, Latin America, Caribbean, Asia and Oceania, subject to local law and partner licensing requirements.
agreement_document: YHVH Gospel TV Global Channel Distribution & Content Partnership Agreement
legal_note: This registry defines an operational contracting framework. Each definitive agreement must be reviewed for the applicable parties, territory, rights, tax, regulatory, privacy and governing-law requirements before signature.
